tema: Grand Review A1 — The Final Trial

cast_dialogue.linea: The Grand Trial, heroes! Thirty-one lessons behind you. Today you prove that A1 is yours.
I am British, I can ski, and I usually ride my bike to work. Ready!
I speak two languages, I have to study tonight, and I'd like a coffee first.
My mother is a teacher who works with children, and her house is next to the park.
My grandchildren visit me on Sundays. They are the treasure of my old, beautiful house.

banco_oraciones.oracion: Ben is a tall, friendly British man who can ski.
Sofía's mother is a teacher who works with children.
Abuela Carmen's grandchildren visit her on Sundays.
Kenji has to study, but he'd like a coffee first.
She doesn't like spiders, and she never eats candy.
You mustn't smoke in the library.
This isn't the café where we met.
Where does your best friend live?
What would you like to eat?
Do you speak English? Yes, I do.
Is a chef a person who cooks? Yes, it is.
Would you like some tea? Yes, please.

banner_diagnostico.opcion_a: She is a person which helps children.
banner_diagnostico.opcion_b: She is a person who helps children.

inicio.definicion_pragmatica: The Grand Trial covers all of A1: to be, pronouns, articles, plurals, demonstratives, present simple, present continuous, have got, imperatives, modals, prepositions, adjectives, possessive 's, relative clauses and Wh- questions.

filas: to be, pronouns, articles, plurals, demonstratives
can, must, should, have to, would like, imperatives, have got
A chef is a person who cooks.

ejercicios.pregunta: A chef is a person ___ cooks.
She ___ up at six and ___ coffee at night. (wake / never drink)

ejercicios.afirmacion: Adjectives in English take a plural '-s'.

ejercicios.texto: A library is a place ___ you can read.

ejercicios.texto_con_error: He don't have to wear a uniform.
ejercicios.respuesta: He doesn't have to wear a uniform.

ejercicios.instruccion: Make it negative, then a question.
ejercicios.respuesta: She can't swim. / Can she swim?

ejercicios.pregunta: Introduce yourself completely: name, nationality, routine, ability and dream. (5 sentences.)
ejercicios.respuesta: I am Ana. I am Mexican. I wake up at seven. I can swim. I would like to visit Japan.

guion: Aurora: The Grand Trial! Heroes, show me everything you know.
Ben: I am British. I can ski, and I never work on Sundays.
Kenji: I speak two languages. I have to study tonight, but I'd like a coffee first.
Sofía: My mother is a teacher who works with children. Her house is next to the park.
Abuela Carmen: And my grandchildren visit me on Sundays. They are my treasure!
Aurora: Perfect, heroes. A1 is yours!

reading.texto: The heroes finish their A1 journey. Ben is a tall, friendly British man who can ski and never works on Sundays. Kenji speaks two languages and has to study tonight. Sofía's mother is a teacher who works with children. Abuela Carmen's grandchildren visit her on Sundays; they are her treasure. They can all speak English now. The Grand Trial is complete!

preguntas.afirmacion: Carmen's grandchildren visit her on Sundays.

ejercicios.texto: She ___ (wake) up at six and ___ (never/drink) coffee.
A chef is a person ___ cooks. (who/which/where)
He has to wear a uniform. → pregunta
Corrige: 'A beach is a place which people swim.'
Escríbete una carta de presentación de 6 oraciones usando: to be, presente simple, can, have to, would like y una oración de relativo.

answer_key: 5. She can't swim. / Can she swim?
7. Does he have to wear a uniform?
9. A beach is a place where people swim.
10. Respuesta libre (ej. 'I am Ana. I am Mexican. I wake up at seven. I can swim. I have to study. I would like a bike. My mother is a teacher who works with children.')
